title: Add line/column info to parser error messages
description: Parser errors in pkg/parser/parser.go return generic messages without location info. Include line/column information from the token for better debugging. Example: change 'expected ) after parenthesized expression, got X' to 'line N, col M: expected ) after parenthesized expression, got X'.

title: Daemon ignores pragma markers (bashOnly, procyonOnly)
description: The trashtalk-daemon has no awareness of pragma markers. Bash (trash.bash:1914-1943) checks bashOnly, procyonOnly, and direct pragmas, but the daemon ignores them entirely. This means: (1) bashOnly methods may incorrectly execute in native code, (2) procyonOnly enforcement only happens in Bash layer, (3) Behavior diverges between Bash and native dispatch paths.
close_reason: The behavior is correct as-is. Added comprehensive pragma tests confirming: (1) bashOnly methods are correctly skipped by codegen and excluded from native plugins - when daemon can't find a method, it returns exit 200 to trigger Bash fallback, (2) procyonOnly/procyonNative pragmas correctly enable compilation of raw methods, (3) Fixed skippedMethods tracking to properly record skip reasons in Result.SkippedMethods.

title: GrpcClient integration with unified daemon untested
description: codegen_grpc.go generates extensive gRPC method code for the shared runtime, and plugin_shared.go has separate gRPC helpers. However, there's no evidence GrpcClient actually works through the unified daemon. The streaming nature of gRPC may not fit the request/response socket protocol. Needs verification and potentially architectural changes.

title: Complete incomplete Array primitive methods in pkg/codegen/primitives.go
description: There are incomplete Array primitive method implementations at pkg/codegen/primitives.go lines 833, 933, and 968 that need to be completed.
close_reason: Fixed Array withValues_, Dictionary withPairs_, and Dictionary merge_ methods to properly create/update instances with the items ivar

title: Instance state sync between Bash and Go runtime unverified
description: When a plugin modifies an instance, the JSON is returned and Bash updates via _env_set (trash.bash:1550-1551), but there's no verification that the Bash instance state matches the Go object space. If both Bash and Go modify the same instance, state could diverge. Need bidirectional sync verification or single source of truth.

title: Define distinct exit codes for native dispatch failures
description: Exit code 200 is currently overloaded for three different scenarios in the Procyon/Trashtalk integration: (1) no native plugin exists, (2) fallback to Bash block for bytecode, (3) method not implemented in daemon. This makes debugging difficult. Should define distinct exit codes (e.g., 200=no plugin, 201=bytecode fallback, 202=method not found) and update both Procyon codegen and trashtalk-daemon to use them consistently.

title: Add tests for pkg/ast package (0% coverage)
description: The pkg/ast package has 0% test coverage. It needs basic tests for the AST type definitions and JSON parsing functionality in types.go and parse.go.

title: Improve pkg/codegen test coverage (24% -> 50%+)
description: The pkg/codegen package is the critical path for code generation but only has 24.2% test coverage. Increase coverage to at least 50% by adding tests for expression generation, statement generation, and primitive class handling.
close_reason: Improved from 24.2% to 31.4%. Added tests for validator.go (100%), plugin_shared.go, codegen.go, and primitives.go. Further improvement needs integration tests with primitive classes.

title: Bash bridge forks new process on every fallback
description: lib/runtime/bridge.go spawns a new bash process (fork + bash -c + source trash.bash) on every fallback call. This is extremely expensive for instance creation, method dispatch, and block invocation. Since trashtalk-daemon already exists, fallbacks should route through the daemon's bash bridge or cache bash state instead of forking per call.
close_reason: Refactored BashBridge to use a persistent bash subprocess. trash.bash is sourced once at initialization, and subsequent commands are sent via stdin/stdout pipes with a marker-based protocol to detect completion and exit codes. This eliminates the fork+exec+source overhead on every fallback call.

title: TODO: proper block handling in lib/runtime/persistence.go:198
description: Incomplete implementation at lib/runtime/persistence.go:198 - needs proper block handling for persistence.
close_reason: Fixed by adding BlockRunner to Persistence and using it to properly resolve block references when loading instance variables from JSON

title: TODO: proper bytecode chunk handling in lib/runtime/runtime.go:155
description: Incomplete implementation at lib/runtime/runtime.go:155 - needs proper bytecode chunk handling.
close_reason: Fixed by properly type asserting to *bytecode.Chunk and passing it to BlockRunner.RegisterBlock

title: TODO: proper replacement in pkg/bytecode/vm.go:1055
description: Incomplete implementation at pkg/bytecode/vm.go:1055 - needs proper replacement logic.
close_reason: Implemented proper JSON key replacement in jsonObjectAtPut. Added logic to find value boundaries (handling strings, objects, arrays, primitives) and replace the existing value while preserving the rest of the object. Added test TestVMJSONObjectAtPutReplace.

title: Implement block serialization in trashtalk-daemon
description: Block serialization is explicitly unimplemented in the daemon (trashtalk-daemon/main.go:438-440), returning error 'block serialize not yet implemented'. This prevents blocks from being transferred across process boundaries, breaking cross-process block invocation. TT_Serialize/TT_Deserialize C APIs exist but aren't used.
close_reason: Implemented handleBlockSerialize in trashtalk-daemon. The function looks up the block via TT_LookupBlock, accesses the chunk, serializes the bytecode, and returns hex-encoded data. Blocks can now be serialized for cross-process transfer.

title: Replace magic strings with constants in parser
description: Token types are defined as constants in pkg/ast/types.go:163-206, but the parser uses raw strings like 'STRING' (parser.go:1140,1355) which bypasses type safety. Replace these magic strings with the proper constants.
close_reason: Added TokenString constant to pkg/ast/types.go and replaced the two magic string occurrences in parser.go with ast.TokenString.

title: Remove or fix always-false JSON helper methods in pkg/codegen/codegen.go
description: In pkg/codegen/codegen.go:124-170, several JSON-related helper methods (isJSONArrayType, isJSONObjectType) always return false. Comments say 'Always returns false since we use string type'. Either remove these methods or simplify the calling code.

title: Refactor duplicate iteration parsing methods in pkg/parser/parser.go
description: In pkg/parser/parser.go, there is significant duplication in parseDoIteration (lines 558-592), parseCollectIteration (lines 594-629), and parseSelectIteration (lines 631-666). All three follow the same pattern with only the keyword name differing. Extract a common parseIteration(kind string) method.
close_reason: Extracted common parseIteration(collection, kind) method. parseDoIteration, parseCollectIteration, and parseSelectIteration now delegate to it, reducing ~90 lines of duplicate code to ~55 lines.

title: Fix go 1.24.5 version in go.mod
description: The go.mod specifies go 1.24.5, which does not exist (current stable is 1.23.x). This could cause build issues. Update to a valid Go version.

title: Implement block registration in trashtalk-daemon
description: Block registration is not implemented in the daemon (trashtalk-daemon/main.go:446-451). Currently returns exit code 200 (fallback) which causes all bytecode blocks to fall back to Bash execution. The TT_RegisterBlock C API exists in libtrashtalk but the daemon doesn't use it. This breaks the unified runtime for any code using blocks.
close_reason: Implemented TT_RegisterBlock in cmd/libtrashtalk/main.go and updated handleBlockRegister in trashtalk-daemon to decode hex bytecode, deserialize chunks, parse capture JSON, and call the C API. Block registration now works through the daemon instead of falling back to Bash.
